content.text: Pherus Collective is built on a simple idea: shared ownership. Instead of one party controlling a system others depend on, Collective is meant to explore what it looks like when the people using a system also own and shape it.
It's decentralised by design, for building and creating things together rather than handing that power to a single operator.
[This project is still being defined. Full details, features, and technology choices will be published here once there's something real to show.]
